title: KPIs & reports
description: Annex B indicators of the project proposal, computed live from records — never estimated.
footnote: All figures are computed from platform records. The platform makes no selection or jury decisions; indicators are for visibility only.

funnel.title: Programme funnel
funnel.subtitle: Every step from application to final: actual, target and conversion from the previous step

charts.turkicSub: {unis} universities · {countries} countries (pilot host and invited partners)
charts.completionSub: Tasks completed per incubation week · {done}/{total} overall ({pct}%)
charts.weekNote: The faded bar is the current, unfinished week. W0 = preparation before incubation.

definitions.title: KPI definitions (Annex B)
definitions.subtitle: How each indicator is computed, what evidence supports it and how often it is reported

applicationsEvaluated.name: Applications evaluated
applicationsEvaluated.definition: Number of unique applications with at least one submitted jury evaluation on the selection rubric.
applicationsEvaluated.evidence: Rubric score sheets in the platform; application register.

teamsAccepted.name: Teams accepted
teamsAccepted.definition: Applications accepted by a recorded human decision and converted into an incubation project.
teamsAccepted.evidence: Decision rationale, signed participation commitment form.

prototypes.name: Functional prototypes / MVP
prototypes.definition: Projects whose prototype/MVP has been verified as working by a mentor or coordinator, backed by test evidence.
prototypes.evidence: Test protocol, demo video, trial results.

qcPackages.name: QC-passed application packages
qcPackages.definition: Competition packages whose required checklist documents are all approved and that passed quality control.
qcPackages.evidence: Document checklist, reviewer notes, version history.

finalists.name: Finalist teams
finalists.definition: Projects officially announced as finalists by the competition organiser. Pilot target 10, scale-up target 50.

mentoringHours.name: Mentoring hours
mentoringHours.definition: Sum of durations of completed mentor sessions (cancelled sessions excluded).
mentoringHours.evidence: Session records, mentor notes and next steps.

taskCompletion.name: Task completion
taskCompletion.definition: Weekly count and overall share of tasks moved to “Done” with their acceptance criterion met.
taskCompletion.evidence: Task history, evidence links, audit log.

turkicReach.name: Turkic-world reach
turkicReach.definition: Number of universities and countries with projects; pilot host and invited partners shown separately.
